recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-18511 unless a future work group decision changes the intended OperationOutcome success example guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-18511 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification for the STU3 OperationOutcome examples asking to change "An operation outcome that would be returned after a successful operation" to "An operation outcome that could be returned after a successful operation" because returning an OperationOutcome for success is unusual rather than expected.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to merge commit 33d5e5b1fcf56f67fcadae337f744d86b802c4bb. Its merged application commit e1690824540746b5a3371c9aa6fb51ffc653b690 changed the OperationOutcome spreadsheet example description from "would" to "could". Later source refactoring moved that example list into source/operationoutcome/list-OperationOutcome-examples.xml.
additional_context: OperationOutcome is active in source/fhir.ini as a resource and special resource, so the current source example list is in current build scope. The current example list says "could be returned". Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant records that conflict with the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/operationoutcome/list-OperationOutcome-examples.xml already contains the requested wording.
